messages:
sasha: quick note 7 drafting a compact plan for a staggered DP/beta (three small waves) to validate private/dedicated onboarding, routing fallbacks, and paired-eval prompt quality. aiming for low churn and clear exit criteria.

michael: high level ok. do we want incentives? and how strict on legal for wave B?

sasha: yes to incentives (small credit + gift card), wave B needs a trimmed data addendum not full legal review.

lina: propose 3 waves: A (hosted, light-touch), B (dedicated/private, infra contact + addendum), C (legal-heavy, standby). each wave 4 weeks active + 1 week wrap.

kevin: ops: must reserve a labeled buffer pool per wave to avoid preemption. will file quota request if owners lock dates.

julia: recruitment list ready. suggest we require partners provide 8 representative prompt pairs and agree to 20-min weekly syncs.

sasha: drafting acceptance checklist now. please review:
- enrollment: 8 partners committed across waves (min 5 active by week 2)
- onboarding: first successful inference within 48h of activation
- observability: token-level latency + per-route errors visible in console
- routing: fallback exercised and reproduced in our staging runbook >= 2 times
- quality: paired-eval baseline per partner with >=90% baseline win-rate or no >10pp regression
- feedback: weekly sync + 5-question micro-survey; partner NPS >=7 for successful exit

michael: tweak: define paired-eval sample size (50 per partner per wave). also add requirement that partners sign opt-in telemetry for analysis.

lina: i'll build intake + paired-eval rubric. small ask: make the rubric human-preference based rather than BLEU/F1 for clarity.

kevin: blockers: current GPU quota has two large jobs in the window. ETA to free buffer unknown. flagging as risk.

julia: blocker: ClearBank likely needs full legal; mark them standby.

sasha: owners: michael (comm + invites), lina (intake & evals), kevin (ops + quota), julia (recruitment), sasha (coord). can we all add a single blocker by EOD?

michael: will draft invite and trimmed addendum today.

lina: intake form and rubric by EOD tomorrow.

(dp-bot): Created ticket BETA-221 "staggered-dp-cohort-2025" (assignee: sasha).
